session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Up, Wedge Reversal Then Trading Range Day' (ET+13 hrs, Jan 22/23). Big gap up open to 6965 with a wedge reversal dumping to the 6925 lows (blue box bar 12), then a small pullback bull trend with consecutive wedges and High 1 entries to the high of day 6962; double top at 6964 (red dotted) led a tight bear channel with 2nd leg down and a truncated wedge at the 6933 lows (bar 72) into the closing chips near 6948. Inset: gap up open and wedge on the daily chart.
